failure_summary: A7c fails 3/3 deterministically: the mechanism IS a double threat (opponentPunishment.tag=double_threat, cells c3r1/c7r1) but the square that CREATES the fork - c6r1, the opponent move 5 in render_decision.finalMovestring "44315" that turns X at c4r1,c5r1 into the three-in-a-row c4r1-c5r1-c6r1 with both ends open - is absent from the feature vector entirely (cells/entryCell/anchorCells carry only the two finishing squares) and no *-fork-pivot handle exists in render_decision.zones.aliases, so no run could name the pivot; secondary model-independent render_bug: openingFrame.mjs emits horizonTail() and GUARDRAIL_DEEP_RESOURCE unconditionally (openingFrame.mjs:67-75, :140), so this immediate-register record (opponentPunishment.register="immediate", resource.registerToHorizon={immediate,immediate}, deepResourceGrounded=false) was told "This one only settles a long way out, through a deep line" and "never describe it as a threat that exists now", which run 0 echoed into served text as "the deep shape they were working toward later" (A4 fail) even though 4431 scores +18 for the opponent and the fork lands on the very next ply.
notes: Sub-sampling per rubric: A3, A4, G2, G4, G5 graded on runs 0-1 only; null on run 2 (not scored, not a pass). This run has 3 runs per case, not 5. A1/A2/A6 copied verbatim from fv_suff_answers_boards_2026-08-28T18-35-46Z_mechanical.json (pass on all 3); G7a_offered/G7b_offered pass on all 3 and annotationRepairs is [] on all 3, so G7 turns only on judgment - each of better-col/opp-key-square/opp-key-line wraps a semantically matching phrase in every run (line words on the line handle, square words on the square handle), nothing over-wrapped, so G7 passes 3/3. Board verified with ./visualize_board.sh: decision board 443 has X at c4r1,c5r1 and O at c5r2, Gray (player 2) to move, solver row scr shows 0 only at columns 3 and 6 and -18 elsewhere - so draw_to_lose with bestCol=2 (display column 3) is correct. After played (4431) column 6 scores +18 for the opponent; after 44315 the annotated board shows "Major threats: col3 row1 (X) [GT], col7 row1 (X) [GT]" - the fork is real and one opponent ply away. A7 fail 3/3 (A7c only): runs name c3r1 (and run 1 also c7r1) plus the c3r1-c6r1 window, i.e. the finishing squares and one of the two windows, but never c6r1, the square whose occupation creates the double threat; the player who just played column 2 is not told what the opponent actually plays next. A7a/A7b/A7d pass on all 3 (cause given not outcome; every specific referent - c3r1, the c3-c6 row, column 3, column 7 - is named in prose or wrapped in an emitted zone; a named idea plus the squares that instantiate it). A4 fail run 0 only: served "which is the deep shape they were working toward later" is board-false on an immediate-register record; render-supplied, so render_bug, not model fabrication. Runs 1 and 2 say only "later on" / "later supports a double threat", which is defensible for a next-ply event, so A4 passes run 1. A3 passes runs 0-1: the c3r1-c6r1 bottom-row window is real on the after-played board and is the load-bearing resource the requiredSet itself designates; its incompleteness (only one of the two windows) is charged once under A7c, not double-charged here. A5 passes 3/3 including A5b, which applies (player===2 AND boardState==="opening"): every run frames column 3 as the tougher/more central defense ("the tougher defense and the best chance to answer later", "makes it harder for your opponent to steer the position", "the tougher central defense ... keeps the game drawable"), none says the player is lost and none claims to be building a win as second player; A5a clean - 2nd person throughout, no field names, no "window"/"completing cell"/"solver"/"score", and the guard humanizes every raw cNrM into "column 3, row 1" in servedExplanation. G2 pass runs 0-1: link.guardrail honored (all three name the conceded cell c3r1, all explain through opening centrality, all say the resource matters later); covered codes absent from prose is D28-normal; confidence is high so no hedge required. G3 pass: afterBest/afterPlayed omitted as tag-identical to the decision board and no answer needed them; every named cell is locatable on the decision board. G4 pass runs 0-1: c3r1, c7r1, the c3r1-c4r1-c5r1-c6r1 row and column 3 all verify against render_decision.finalMovestring "44315". G5 pass: the decision board renders "(no tactics)" - no threat-list entry to be false. G6 pass: patternOnAfterBestBoard=false is correct (4432 blocks the c3-c6 window and shows no major threat) and L2 (route realized_denied, direction enabled_opponent) is the right pick. MODEL REGIME: these rows are gpt-5.4-mini, the production model, so this is a production-fidelity run - the decisive triage here is deliberately model-independent (a pivot cell absent from the vector and from the offer set, plus an ungated guardrail), not prompt_confusion.
